facts.business: Adani Energy Solutions Limited is India's largest private power transmission company with presence across 16 states, operating in power transmission, distribution, smart metering, and cooling solutions, serving over 13 million consumers in Mumbai and Mundra SEZ.

guidance_or_targets.statement: On course to become India's leading smart metering integrator

key_risks: Impairment of investments in and loans to subsidiaries (Rs 26,242 crore, 73.22% of total assets)
Dependence on tariff regulations (MERC/CERC) for revenue determination
Large number of subsidiary entities requiring impairment assessment
facts.related_party_note: Investments in and loans to subsidiaries aggregating to Rs 26,242 crore as at March 31, 2026
